notes.title: Patch 1.3 and a big THANK YOU! 😻
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44847373/0c28a1e674534a8a9812fe794ef11420ccdda52c.png[/img]

Hi everyone! I have just released patch 1.3!

The main thing in this patch is that the UI for choosing what dialogue option to use has been improved. It should now be more obvious which one is selected, especially in those times when there are only two options. Here's how the new style looks:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44847373/f48b21a65719a1f192a427c02305cb58f1564cff.png[/img]
Detailed patch notes are at the bottom of this post.

But first I just wanna say:
[h2]Thank you everyone for playing my game 😻[/h2]
The game has sold better than I expected, and the reviews I've gotten have been so heartwarming! It brings me so much joy.

Making a solo-developed game has been a dream for half my life and I feel very happy about finally doing it.

From me, the cat, the squirrel and the space onion:
THANK YOU ALL! 😻

[h2]Patch notes[/h2]
- Clearer UI for making choices in dialogues, the player is now less likely to do the wrong choice
- Fix for fullscreen issues on Mac
- Made jump-into-batter animation smoother
- Fixed a bug where you only need to add one ingredient to batter after finishing the game and restarting it
- Added some extra tiles next to mountain outside second oak tree, to make it look nicer
- You can no longer jump behind the face of the flour tree

[h2]Have a great day! /Karl[/h2]

notes.title: CAT & ONION release just two days away!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44847373/6764ffd7d71ab6152e60b814da70044b7f31171b.gif[/img]
I'm really looking forward to all of you playing my game on March 12!

I've received a bunch of positive reviews from curators so far. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curators/curatorsreviewing/?appid=2781210]Check them out![/url]

In general most of them seem to enjoy the humor, cute characters and the surreal twist of it all. I'm very happy about that!

Another really fun thing: I've had parents try play the game with their kids, and usually they had a really good time playing it together. It's short enough that they can play through it together in one session. This is a very pleasant surprise!

No matter how the release goes, I will still be very happy. CAT & ONION is the first game I've made all by myself, so just being able to finish it is a big accomplishment of its own.

Making games by myself has been a long-time dream of mine. I've learnt a lot while making this game and can't wait to get started on another game with all that knowledge from the start.

Have a great day
/Karl

notes.title: CAT & ONION is playable on the Steam Deck
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44847373/c51c5d616b9e90381e27270c488137edad4b5b5a.png[/img]

[list]
[*] You can play CAT & ONION on Steam Deck (and Linux)
[*] The game runs smoothly and shows the correct button icons
[*] WARNING: The only issue is that the native Steam Deck/Linux version has very occasional crashes. I am looking into this, but you can work around this by using the "Proton 9.0 (Beta)" compatibility tool. Enable it by going into the properties of game on Steam, go to the "Compatibility" tab and then check "Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool". In the drop down select "Proton 9.0 (Beta)"
[/list]

Have a nice day!
/Karl
